text.p: Cabot Oil & Gas Corp said Tuesday directors elected Edgar J. Milan as Vice President and Chief Financial Officer and promoted James M. Trimble to the newly created post of senior vice president, exploration and production.

Milan replaces Ray Seegmiller, who in February 1997 was promoted to Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer. Milan most recently served as Senior Vice President & Chief Financial Officer for Tenneco Europe Ltd, in London, and Vice President, Tenneco Inc.

Cabot Oil said Trimble will oversee the company's expanding exploration and production efforts including allocating resources between regions for exploration projects. He served most recently serving as vice president, business development and engineering.
